change.productPagePreviewSection: Data Not Linked to You / Diagnostics

basis: Current AppMeasurement uses no custom user ID or arbitrary logs/keys. Nonfatal NSError is reduced to a closed operation/family/code vocabulary.
Installed FirebaseCrashlytics privacy manifest declares Crash Data and Other Diagnostic Data as App Functionality, unlinked and nontracking.
Crash sharing is independent, optional and default-off.
